title: Don't See Evidence That US is on 'Back Heels' Against Iran, Says Megan Ortagus
summary:
Morgan Ortagus, a former deputy presidential special envoy, said she doesn't see proof of the narrative that the US is on its 'back heels' in negotiations with Iran and that strategic patience is on the side of the United States. 
Ortagus said that while military options are still on the table, what the Iranian regime is most scared of is not the US or Israel, but the uprising of its own people. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Stocks Fall After Iran Says Strait of Hormuz Will Remain Shut
summary: US stocks turned lower Tuesday after Iran said the Strait of Hormuz would remain closed until its conditions were met, pushing oil prices higher.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 11

title: CoreWeave’s Forecast Is Key to Stopping Another Earnings Selloff

summary: Systematic buyers are getting ready to load up on stocks again after a massive unwind, according to Citadel Securities.

title: Emerging Assets Fall as Iran Hopes Fade and Oil Nears $90
summary: Emerging-market assets extended losses on Tuesday, with most currencies weakening against the dollar and equities falling as Iran pushed back against earlier optimism over a potential deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, underscoring the fragility of sentiment around the conflict.

title: Hawaii Taps Muni Market to Finish First US Driverless Rail Line
summary: Hawaii’s capital is trading surfboards for light-rail trains as it bets on a new way to get around.

title: Indonesia Copper Shipments Delayed by Gresik Smelter Outage
summary: Copper shipments from Indonesia are suffering delays after the smelter that processes ore from the giant Grasberg mine was halted because of a boiler leak over the weekend.

title: US Sees Iran War Oil Supply Disruptions Lasting Through 2027
summary: The US now expects oil supply disruptions stemming from the US-Iran war to reach about 600,000 barrels per day through the end of next year as the conflict continues to crimp shipments via the critical Strait of Hormuz.

title: Uber Exits Serve Robotics Stake as Delivery Alliance Unravels

title: Trump Defends Embattled FIFA President Infantino
summary:
Donald Trump threw his weight behind Gianni Infantino, warning it would be a "terrible mistake" to oust the FIFA president.

Tiwa Adebayo explains the deepening crisis at the heart of global football. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Chile Cuts Copper Production Forecast Again as Mine Woes Persist
summary: Chile lowered its copper production forecast for a second straight quarter as weaker output from some of the country’s biggest mines adds to supply constraints that have helped push up prices.

title: 'Guac Signal' Sparked Chipotle's Frantic Bid to Recall Jalapeños
summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill Inc. figured out that jalapeños were the source of a salmonella outbreak and began an automated recall system to notify restaurants and destroy the tainted peppers. The company was able to identify the problematic ingredient before health agencies announced nationwide recalls, and it quickly replaced the jalapeños with batches from different growers. Bloomberg's Daniela Sirtori joined Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Blue Owl Set to Raise $750 Million to Pay Down Credit Lines

title: A Dozen Ships Switch Oil Outside Hormuz as US Touts Transits

title: South Africa Vows Eskom Won’t Weaken After Transmission Restructuring
